title: Tooltip
description: A short text label shown when the user hovers over or focuses an element. Near the viewport edges it flips and shifts to stay visible.

props.name: content
props.description: Text displayed inside the tooltip (or the `content` slot)

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the tooltip is shown (controlled, `v-model:open`)

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state (uncontrolled)

props.name: placement
props.description: Placement relative to the trigger

props.name: color
props.description:
Semantic color of the tooltip. With the `glass` variant the color only
tints the border (neutral keeps the plain frosted surface)

props.name: variant
props.description:
Visual style: `solid` (filled; neutral is the inverted contrasting
surface), `subtle` (tinted surface with a border) or `glass` (frosted
elevated surface)

props.name: shape
props.description: Shape of the tooltip

props.name: animation
props.description: Show / hide animation

props.name: enterDelay
props.description: Delay before showing on hover, in milliseconds

props.name: leaveDelay
props.description: Delay before hiding on mouse leave, in milliseconds

props.name: offset
props.description:
Offset as [x, y] in pixels. For top/bottom placements `y` is the gap to
the trigger and `x` shifts along it; for left/right placements `x` is the
gap and `y` shifts along it. Without it the tooltip sits 8px away.

props.name: followCursor
props.description: Makes the tooltip follow the mouse cursor

props.name: zIndex
props.description: z-index of the tooltip

props.name: arrow
props.description: Shows an arrow pointing at the trigger

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the tooltip

props.name: className
props.description: Additional class name of the trigger wrapper (`class` works too)

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible label of the tooltip element (`aria-label`)

props.name: asChild
props.description:
Attaches the hover / focus handlers, the ref and `class` directly to the
single child element instead of wrapping it in a `<div>` (keeps flex
and grid layouts intact).

props.name: contentClassName
props.description:
Additional class name of the tooltip (floating) element. To customize
the colors, set the `--tooltip-bg` (background, gradients allowed) and
`--tooltip-color` (text) custom properties on it

props.name: contentRef
props.type: Ref<HTMLDivElement | null, HTMLDivElement | null> | ((element: HTMLDivElement | null) => void)
props.description:
Ref to the tooltip (floating) element, set while it is shown: a ref
object or a callback (also exposed as `contentElement`)
props.typeText: Ref<HTMLDivElement | null, HTMLDivElement | null> | ((element: HTMLDivElement | null) => void)

slots.name: default
slots.description: The element that triggers the tooltip; prefer a focusable element

slots.name: content
slots.description: Content displayed inside the tooltip (the `content` prop)

props.name: enterDelay
props.description:
Default delay before showing on hover, in milliseconds, for every Tooltip
inside that does not set `enterDelay`

props.name: leaveDelay
props.description:
Default delay before hiding on mouse leave, in milliseconds, for every
Tooltip inside that does not set `leaveDelay`

props.name: skipDelay
props.description:
When another tooltip of the provider closed less than this many
milliseconds ago, the next one opens without waiting for its enter delay

vars.name: --tooltip-radius
vars.description: Corner radius (defaults to the radius of the shape)

vars.name: --tooltip-shadow
vars.description: Shadow (defaults to --shadow-md, --shadow-lg for the glass variant)

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue";
import { Tooltip, Button, HStack } from "minerva-design/vue";
const open = ref(false);
</script>
<template>
  <HStack :gap="3" wrap
    ><Button @click="open = !open">Toggle tooltip</Button
    ><Tooltip v-model:open="open" content="Controlled by Vue state"
      ><Button variant="outline">Anchor</Button></Tooltip
    ><output>{{ open ? "Open" : "Closed" }}</output></HStack
  >
</template>

translationResources.title: Tooltip
translationResources.description: A short text label shown when the user hovers over or focuses an element. Near the viewport edges it flips and shifts to stay visible.

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: Wrap a focusable element. The tooltip shows on hover and on keyboard focus, and Escape closes it, even when it was opened by hover.

colors.title: Colors
colors.description: color picks the semantic color: neutral (default), info, success, warning or danger.

variants.title: Variants
variants.description: variant picks the style: solid (default; filled, the neutral one is an inverted surface that contrasts with the theme), subtle (tinted surface with a border) or glass (frosted surface that follows the theme; the color tints its border).

shapes.title: Shapes
shapes.description: Default, rounded, square and thought-bubble shapes.

animations.title: Animations
animations.description: Choose how the tooltip enters and leaves.

custom-colors.title: Custom colors, arrow and offset
custom-colors.description: Set the --tooltip-bg (solid colors and CSS gradients) and --tooltip-color custom properties on the tooltip through contentClassName; arrow adds a pointer to the trigger; offset sets the gap to the trigger (8px by default).

delays.title: Delays and disabled
delays.description: enterDelay and leaveDelay control the hover timing; disabled turns the tooltip off.

follow-cursor.title: Follow cursor
follow-cursor.description: With followCursor the tooltip tracks the mouse pointer.

controlled.title: Controlled and imperative
controlled.description: Control visibility with open and onOpenChange (hover, focus and Escape still request changes), or call open / close / toggle on a TooltipRef.

events.title: Events
events.description: onOpen and onClose fire on hover, focus, blur and Escape.

as-child.title: asChild
as-child.description: asChild attaches the tooltip to the child itself, without a wrapper element, so flex and grid layouts stay intact. contentClassName styles the tooltip.

provider.title: TooltipProvider
provider.description: A TooltipProvider sets default delays for the tooltips inside; moving quickly from one tooltip to the next opens it immediately.

TooltipProps.children: The element that triggers the tooltip; prefer a focusable element
TooltipProps.open: Whether the tooltip is shown (controlled; pair with onOpenChange)
TooltipProps.color: Semantic color of the tooltip. With the glass variant the color only tints the border (neutral keeps the plain frosted surface)
TooltipProps.variant: Visual style: solid (filled; neutral is the inverted contrasting surface), subtle (tinted surface with a border) or glass (frosted elevated surface)
TooltipProps.enterDelay: Delay before showing on hover, in milliseconds
TooltipProps.leaveDelay: Delay before hiding on mouse leave, in milliseconds
TooltipProps.offset: Offset as [x, y] in pixels. For top/bottom placements y is the gap to the trigger and x shifts along it; for left/right placements x is the gap and y shifts along it. Without it the tooltip sits 8px away
TooltipProps.followCursor: Makes the tooltip follow the mouse cursor
TooltipProps.arrow: Shows an arrow pointing at the trigger
TooltipProps.className: Additional class name of the trigger wrapper
TooltipProps.onOpen: Called when the tooltip opens from hover or focus
TooltipProps.onClose: Called when the tooltip closes from mouse leave, blur or Escape
TooltipProps.aria-label: Accessible label of the tooltip element
TooltipProps.ref: Imperative handle with open / close / toggle
TooltipProps.onOpenChange: Called with the requested open state (hover, focus, Escape, ref methods)
TooltipProps.asChild: Attaches the hover / focus handlers, the ref and className directly to the single child element instead of wrapping it in a <div> (keeps flex and grid layouts intact). The child must accept a ref
TooltipProps.contentClassName: Additional class name of the tooltip (floating) element. To customize the colors, set the --tooltip-bg (background, gradients allowed) and --tooltip-color (text) custom properties on it
TooltipProps.contentRef: Ref to the tooltip (floating) element, set while it is shown

TooltipProviderProps.enterDelay: Default delay before showing on hover, in milliseconds, for every Tooltip inside that does not set enterDelay
TooltipProviderProps.leaveDelay: Default delay before hiding on mouse leave, in milliseconds, for every Tooltip inside that does not set leaveDelay
TooltipProviderProps.skipDelay: When another tooltip of the provider closed less than this many milliseconds ago, the next one opens without waiting for its enter delay

cssVars.--tooltip-radius: Corner radius (defaults to the radius of the shape)
cssVars.--tooltip-shadow: Shadow (defaults to --shadow-md, --shadow-lg for the glass variant)

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: Wrap a focusable trigger: the content attribute is shown on hover and focus. placement accepts 12 positions, arrow adds an arrow and disabled turns the tooltip off.

styles.title: Colors, variants, shapes and animations
styles.description: color sets the semantic tone, variant the surface (solid, subtle, glass), shape the outline and animation the enter / exit transition.

provider.title: Provider and rich content
provider.description: <minerva-tooltip-provider> gives the tooltips inside shared delays; moving to the next tooltip within skip-delay opens it at once. The content slot holds markup.

controlled.title: Methods, events and follow cursor
controlled.description: show(), hide() and toggle() drive a tooltip directly (without firing events); hover and focus fire the cancelable minerva-open-change. follow-cursor tracks the pointer, offset sets the gap.

events.minerva-open-change: Hover, focus, blur, pointer leave or Escape asked to open / close (detail: { open }); cancelable: preventDefault() keeps the current state.

slots.default: The trigger; prefer a single focusable element (button, link...).
slots.content: Rich tooltip content (alternative to the content attribute).

methods.show: Shows the tooltip (does not fire minerva-open-change).
methods.hide: Hides the tooltip (does not fire minerva-open-change).
methods.toggle: Toggles the tooltip (does not fire minerva-open-change).
